The famous bioanalyst [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Menoda]] maintained a '''laboratory''' during [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but destroyed it and all of his research in protest of the ongoing Republic-Imperial conflict.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Throwing it all Away}}</ref>
